High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Air-2 Racing Swoop]] (Special Edition, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Special Edition/SE Light/Air-2 Racing Swoop.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeQ2NPckpUZjRjb3M/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Air-2 Racing Swoop.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,104 bytes, SHA-256 <code>6f70459e552c72a2ec03f6c393a7510cc62e29f2b0d697b95930c76340ebcdf4</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.
